name: Staff of the Lord Protector
body:
Price 19,800 gp; Aura moderate abjuration; CL 9; Weight 10 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

This ornate golden staff is well balanced and adorned with silver filigree of shields and flowers throughout.

This staff functions as a +1 flaming/+1 frost quarterstaff and also allows the use of the following spells.

shield (1 charge)
shield other (1 charge)
protection from arrows (1 charge)
glyph of warding (2 charges)

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 9,900 gp; Feats Craft Staff; Spells shield, shield other, protection from arrows, glyph of warding
